name: vitr
description: vitr for Windows, Linux and macOS
author: blood

scripts.check: npm run release:check && npm test && node --check web/core.mjs && node --check web/backend.mjs && node --check web/persistence.mjs && node --check web/ui-primitives.mjs && node --check web/ui.mjs && node --check web/window-controls.mjs && node --check web/app.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:windows: npm run icons && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File platforms/windows/generate-installer-art.ps1 -Version 0.1.0 && tauri build --bundles msi,nsis
scripts.tauri:build:linux: npm run icons && tauri build --bundles deb,appimage
scripts.tauri:build:macos: npm run icons && tauri build --bundles dmg
